scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.vercel-build: mkdir -p client/public/uploads && cp -r server/uploads/. client/public/uploads/ && rm -f client/public/uploads/proof-* && npm run build --prefix client
